about_the_game:
Spanning 52 pages, the official Sparklite art book demonstrates how the team at RedBlueGames developed the characters and environment of the game. Drawing on their love of old 8 and 16-bit classics, the team reveal how they imagined and re-imagined the inhabitants of Geodia. Featuring both pixel art and hand-drawn sketches, the artbook covers topics such as:

  • Ada
  • Wingnut
  • Inhabitants of Geodia
  • Creatures
  • Gremlins
  • The Titans
  • The Baron
  • The Refuge
  • The biomes of Geodia
  • Weapons and gadgets
